correctness.rationale: For fixed \(|\zeta|=1\), the analytic series \(F_\zeta(w)=c+\sum_{n\ge1}(a_n\zeta^n+b_n\bar\zeta^n)w^n\) satisfies \(F_\zeta(r)=f(r\zeta)\) exactly. Radial orthogonality gives its weighted Bergman norm coefficient-by-coefficient, and \(|u+v|^2\le2(|u|^2+|v|^2)\) yields \(\lVert F_\zeta\rVert^2\le2\lVert f\rVert^2-|f(0)|^2\). Applying the established analytic Riesz--Fejer inequality then proves the ray bound; evaluating at \(-r\) gives the opposite ray. Boundary checks recover the analytic case with no factor two and correctly give zero for \(f(z)=z-\bar z\) on the real ray.
risks: The argument is specific to \(p=2\); no optimality of the uniform harmonic factor is proved.
